summary: Home page's Latest Changes now loads more entries as you scroll instead of all at once; added "last updated" dates to gathering nodes and vendors, plus a new EA checkmark badge for info confirmed after Early Access launches
Added Soggy Marble Rye (a food item found while fishing), filled in weight/size/class/race for The Final Word, and narrowed Grouper's real minimum skill in Night Harbor
Removed the MnM Classes Map link from Useful Links
Added Crab Cakes, Glimmerscale Herring (a new fish), and confirmed Redfin Pike is also caught in Vale of Zintar; set Grouper's headline minimum fishing skill to the Shaded Dunes value
Noted that Grouper's minimum fishing skill is much lower in Shaded Dunes than in Night Harbor
Refreshed 4 Carpentry recipes' difficulty from a higher-skill crafting window, and confirmed Basa/Whitefish/Grouper are also caught in Shaded Dunes
Added more Carpentry recipes (Wooden Bed, Nightstand, Animal Cart) and refreshed difficulty colors at higher skill; added faction and loot info for a lawbreaker in Night Harbor
Added Thorn Sturgeon as an item and linked it into the Clear Fish Oil recipe, and clarified the Deep Sea Devourer's day-only note
Confirmed how to upgrade Rusty weapons to Tarnished (sharpening stone at an Anvil), added to the Blacksmithing note
Trimmed the Tattered Cloth Boots note further, since it was repeating the Rarity column
Shortened the Tattered Cloth Boots note
Cleared Thorn Sturgeon's unconfirmed minimum fishing skill (noted it was first found at skill 77 instead), and tidied up the Grouper and Tattered Cloth Boots notes
Set Tattered Cloth Boots' minimum fishing skill to 1, and removed Redfin Pike's unconfirmed Night Harbor location and skill requirement
Added A Fishmonger vendor (Night Harbor Docks) and fixed a faction name typo (Pymos -> Pyrmos Mercenaries)
Set Grouper's minimum fishing skill to 70 based on player testing
Added Angelfish Bisque, a new Cooking food item
Updated 8 Carpentry recipes' difficulty and skill level from a fresh crafting-window screenshot at skill 5, and restored Display Box which reappeared
Hid the Fishing table's Bait Required column for now, since every value is currently unknown
Removed redundant Gathering page notes that just repeated what the Min Skill/Trivial columns already show
Cleaned up wording on several Gathering page notes so they read naturally instead of referencing internal data sources
Specified which fish work in the Refined Fish Oil recipe, filled in Deep Sea Devourer's card, and added Sunscale Skimmer (only comes out during the day)
Gave Tattered Cloth Boots a rarity from fishing-yield testing, and corrected Grouper's minimum fishing skill (much higher than previously listed)
Specified which fish work in the Crude Fish Oil recipe (Basa, Whitefish, or Grouper)
Cleaned up cluttered notes on the Fishing table so each fish only shows genuinely useful info
Removed the unconfirmed "Raw" prefix from every Fishing catch, cleared out unconfirmed bait requirements, and added fresh notes on fish rarity from ongoing player testing
Corrected two fish item names (Whitefish and Basa don't actually have a "Raw" prefix, despite what was previously listed) and added their item cards
Added a note to the Gathering page: Tattered Cloth Boots can be caught while fishing in Night Harbor, not just found as monster loot
Added new fish and jewelry items, filled in a missing fish item's description, and updated Woodworking recipe difficulty from a higher-skill observation
Hid 5 old Carpentry recipes (Elder Wood Panel, Elder Wood Panel Frame, Ironbark Frame, Ironbark Panel, Display Box) that no longer appear in the game's current recipe list
Filled in weight, size, and difficulty info for Carpentry furniture recipes, added Woodworking's first two recipes, and added a new vendor (A Carpenter) and item (Furniture Wrench)
Changed the Crafting and Gathering search boxes to filter tradeskills by name instead of searching recipes, since finding the right tradeskill among so many was the slow part
Removed a redundant note under the sidebar's History section
Added a welcome message to the Home page explaining what the wiki is and inviting visitors to help by submitting info
Fixed a duplicate/misspelled item (Grudgeheft vs Grudgehaft) and added new level-1 con-check data for Night Harbor and Evershade Weald monsters
Merged A Shady Trader back into one vendor - Faelindral is a city within Evershade Weald, not a separate zone, so it was the same vendor all along
Split A Shady Trader into two separate vendors (Faelindral and Evershade Weald) instead of one combined entry
Confirmed and highlighted the Blacksmithing Tarnished-upgrade recipe, added Evershade Weald monster/con data, and expanded A Shady Trader's sell list
Added an unverified community note to Blacksmithing about upgrading corroded metal armor into its Tarnished counterpart
Added notes to the Tailoring and Leatherworking pages explaining how to repair Tattered armor into its Patched counterpart
Added Quartermaster Obaid, a Night Harbor Garrison vendor who buys and sells a huge variety of goods, grouped by item type to keep the listing readable
Added new items (First Degree Fourfold Sash, Moonwhisper Circle) and more con-check/level data for Night Harbor's West Gate and Croc Camp monsters
Added a "click to expand/collapse" hint to the Home page's Latest Changes heading
Redesigned the Home page as a one-stop landing page with a button to every other page, and moved Latest Changes below it (now collapsed by default)
Added Squirming Worm and Expert Fishing Pole (fishing gear), an ashira fisher and Finnel Tidehook, and confirmed a couple more monster drops (Murcanthrope Blade, Duelist's Mask)
Pinned Calafrey & Szurr Regions and Aethoril (the world map) above the rest of the Maps page in their own Regional Overview panel, since they cover more than just one place
Fixed a table header tooltip (Ratio column) getting cut off at the edge of the Item Database

Removed the Weight/Size, Capacity/Max Size, Classes, and Race columns from the Item Database table to fix bad text wrapping on narrow screens - that info is still on each item's own card, and still filterable
Recorded data for Antharite, an Elementalist's summoned pet (the Companions page itself is still hidden for now, but ready for more pet types like this one)
Added a Calafrey & Szurr Regions overview map, with a zone-connections diagram you can flip to from the same map viewer
Vendors can now record what they buy, not just what they sell (added An elemental quartermaster's full buy list) - items show which vendors will buy them
Added An elemental quartermaster (Night Harbor's School of the Fourfold Path)
Added Noura the Tailor and Tenebrim Tam (Elementalist trainer) to Night Harbor's Night Market, A Baker vendor, and noted trainer skills that need a certain level instead of a skill number
Vendors & Trainers now groups each section by zone with collapsible headers, so you can find your zone without scrolling past every other one
Fixed the Item Database's new instructions pointing the wrong direction (said 'above' when the Type dropdown is below the text)
Updated the Item Database's instructions to match how it actually works now (click, not hover, to see a card; sorting needs a Type picked)
Redesigned the Item Database so it never freezes: it now loads items in batches as you scroll instead of all at once, and column sorting is enabled once you pick a specific item type
Fixed a follow-up freeze: a single typed letter still matched most items and reloaded the same huge table. Now any search/filter result over 200 items also asks before rendering
Fixed the real cause of the Item Database freezing the page: it no longer loads all ~1900 items automatically. Search, filter, or press "Show all" to see items
Added Night Harbor's Night Market vendors and trainer (A Cobbler, A Spicemonger, Brewer Gromni) and filled in Black Feather Arrow's stats
Fixed a bug causing every page's data to load twice, which could make the site hang on load. Also moved shields/bucklers into the Weapons category and updated Tailoring recipe info
Added real stats to 42 weapon/tool items, confirmed all metal/wood equipment tiers share one item set, and compacted ~38 monsters' drop lists to save space
Updated Fletching recipe skill levels through 105, added Shaded Dunes loot drops, and confirmed Magebloom also yields Arcane Frond
Added more level-32 con data for a Dustrend legionary and a sand giant raider in Vale of Zintar
Confirmed Tattered Cotton is its own separate armor tier (not the same as Tattered Cloth) and grouped its drops into one compact family entry across 9 monsters
Added a Dustrend deshpar and more coin/con/drop data for the Vale of Zintar Dustrend camp monsters, now up to level 32
Removed a mistaken monster entry (Bigshow is a player, not a monster)
Added coin drops, con levels, and faction info for several Fallen Pass and Vale of Zintar monsters, plus a new Dustrend serverat and Bigshow entry
Updated 8 Alchemy recipes' difficulty and skill level from a fresh crafting-window screenshot at skill 101
Recorded the crafter's current Alchemy skill on Lunar Shroud Potion and Potion of Sense Magic, and confirmed Lunar Shroud Potion's recipe genuinely changed in-game
Updated Lunar Shroud Potion and Potion of Sense Magic (Alchemy) with fresher recipe card data
Added Prowler's Wristguard (Fenrix Lightfoot drop, Glass Flats) and a more specific spawn location for a shimmering shadow in Shaded Dunes
Added more Night Harbor Sojourner's Camp vendors and trainers (A Survivalist, A Lumberjack, Survivalist Faiza, Lumberjack Bubir, Outdoorsman Gahira)
Added more Night Harbor Sojourner's Camp vendors and trainers (A Medic, An Herbalist, A Reagent Vendor, A Cleric Scribe, Medic Zafira, Herbalist Zaarid) plus two new magic items
Grouped a vendor's quality-set item groups (Rusty weapons, Tattered armor, etc.) into one compact entry instead of listing every piece; added A Miner (Night Harbor gem vendor)
Added Greedy Merchant vendors (A Shifty Gnome, A Shady Trader, and 3 more) with a new description field explaining what makes them different from a regular vendor
Added Night Harbor's North Gate vendors and trainers (A Smelter, A Rider, A Stablemaster, Rider Kalil, Smelter Harris)
Split spell/ability scroll sellers into their own Spell Vendors section, and stopped showing an inaccurate skill cap number on trainer cards
Added a Zone filter to the Vendors & Trainers page
Added Stygian Moss and Silver Ore items; fixed Rich Tin Vein and Rich Silver Vein to list the same gem/material drops as their normal counterparts
Added Muggrah scrapper zone/coin data and Arcane Frond herb info for Dragon's Vigil and Stygian Moss
Added a Rich Limestone Deposit picture, an ashira lookout's zone/picture, and a clearer jackal pup picture
Added Survivalist Jabool to Vendors & Trainers
Added a new Vendors & Trainers page, plus new Night Harbor vendors and trainers
Temporarily hid the Companions section
Split item cards' Vendors info into its own section, with clickable vendor names showing everything they sell
Updated Alchemy and Fletching skill-ups from the crafting window; renamed sidebar's Recently Updated box to Recently Updated Items
Added Toma the Two-Faced picture/drops/faction info, new sand giant scout, and a smuggler's Shaded Dunes faction data
Removed the splash screen (was causing a visible flash on load)
Temporarily disabled the splash screen
Added new Vale of Zintar monster con checks, loot, and faction data
Added a Home page with a list of recent site updates
